s: is she become as a widow
with her, they are become her enemies

n: Heb. for the greatness of servitude

s: that she had in the days

n: Heb. is become a removing, or, wandering
or, to make the soul to come again

s: nothing to you, all ye that pass

n: or, the winepress of the virgin, etc

s: unto them, as thou hast done
unto me for all my transgressions

What thing shall I take to witness
to thee, that I may comfort
for thee: and they have not discovered
over thee, he hath set up
Surely against me is he turned
me about, that I cannot get out

n: or, rolled me in the ashes
Heb. make to return to my heart

s: if so be there may be
for the punishment of his sins
to the roof of his mouth
For the punishment of the iniquity

n: or, in that they could not but touch

n: or, carry thee captive for thy sins

s: what is come upon us: consider
